decisions.decision: Single arena.html page hosting N pane instances rather than separate windows
decisions.why: createTextStream and live sources are already per-instance factories with AbortSignal isolation
decisions.rejected: separate browser instances — duplicates keys, steering sync, layout

decisions.decision: Provider registry populated by module side-effect registration
decisions.why: avoids provider.ts importing every provider module (cycle); mirrors main.ts side-effect imports
decisions.rejected: static PROVIDERS map — would couple registry to all provider modules

decisions.decision: Pane minimum = story stream + caret knob + Steering + status; no flagship attention/fan machinery
decisions.why: research R5: replicating flagship steering x4 is impractical; spec minimum viable pane

decisions.decision: Capacity is geometric (MIN_PANE_WIDTH=240px, min(4, floor(w/240))), forced to 1 on narrow or short-coarse; coarse pointer alone never caps
decisions.why: spec FR-015 edge case; matches contracts/pane.md

decisions.decision: Shared dimension catalog extracted to src/story/dimensions.ts
decisions.why: steering bar needs dimension editors for all providers; flagship simulatedDimension reuses it
decisions.rejected: duplicating the list in arena code

decisions.decision: pane-config.ts extracted for testable localStorage round-trip
decisions.why: unit tests run in node without DOM
